w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something pads into the clearing — The Redactor. It's here.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Understudy, The Focus Group, Don't-Look) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Henry telling Omar about himself. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
A stranger at the tree line, watching. Not hiding, exactly. Measuring. They'll be gone by dusk — but they'll remember what they saw.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
